Compute a held-out learning curve with explicit curation configuration.

Source: R/curation_model.R
curation_learning_curve.Rd

The fixed held-out split and learner implementation remain in selection_learning_curve().

Usage

curation_learning_curve(
  records,
  reviews,
  config,
  learner = NULL,
  learner_key = NULL,
  sizes = NULL,
  test_frac = 0.25,
  repeats = 10L,
  eval_source = "random",
  threshold = 0.5,
  seed = NULL,
  by_country = FALSE
)

curation_compute_learning_curve(
  records,
  reviews,
  config,
  learner = NULL,
  learner_key = NULL,
  sizes = NULL,
  test_frac = 0.25,
  repeats = 10L,
  eval_source = "random",
  threshold = 0.5,
  seed = NULL,
  by_country = FALSE
)

Arguments

records

A scored and classified record data frame.

reviews

Review rows accepted by curation_train_model().

config

A planscanR_curation_config.

learner

Optional existing learner object.

learner_key

Optional learner-registry key.

sizes

Optional training sizes.

test_frac

Fraction held out per repeat.

repeats

Number of held-out repeats.

eval_source

Review source(s), defaulting to "random".

threshold

Probability cutoff.

seed

Optional seed.

by_country

If TRUE, include held-out country slices.

Value

The long learning-curve tibble from selection_learning_curve().
